articles.summary: Modern Treasury's PSP now powers payments for AppCard, serving 3,300+ independent grocers. The integration adds ACH collections, multi-rail payouts, and real-time ledgering, giving grocers enterprise-grade embedded finance to compete with big chains.
articles.title: AppCard Selects Modern Treasury to Power Payments for Grocery Loyalty Programs

articles.summary: Modern Treasury launched non-custodial Stablecoin Wallets for secure, user-controlled USDG, USDC, and USDT transactions in 90+ countries. Its unified API connects stablecoin wallets with fiat payments, Global USD Accounts, and built-in ledgering.
articles.title: Modern Treasury Launches Non-Custodial Stablecoin Wallets, Bringing Global USD Accounts, Embeddable Wallets, and Orchestration Together through One API
